experiment: VOCdevkit3000 Aligned+WTConv joint-model parameter audit and corrective retraining

dataset.reason_for_staging: OpenCV could not read the original Chinese-character D-drive path in the first smoke test

common_protocol.checkpoint_selection: ordinary or EMA checkpoint with highest exact validation mIoU

original_c3_audit.finding: Original C3 is not C1 plus a WTConv at the same interface.
changes: replaces the native 1024-to-256 fusion mixer with a 1024-to-128 reduction
adds a 128-to-256 expansion and an extra BatchNorm/ReLU
therefore changes fusion capacity and normalization together with WTConv

c4_corrective_from_scratch.structure: native full Aligned fusion 1024-to-256 followed by one 256-channel residual WTConv
c4_corrective_from_scratch.formal_exit_receipt: not captured by the interactive shell session
c4_corrective_from_scratch.interpretation: cleaner than original C3, but seed42 mIoU remains below C0

c5_warm_start_diagnostic.initialization: C1 selected checkpoint loaded; seven new WTConv variables intentionally missing and kept identity-initialized
c5_warm_start_diagnostic.formal_exit_receipt: not captured by the interactive shell session
c5_warm_start_diagnostic.interpretation: improves several regional and boundary metrics over C0, but recall, hard clDice and thin-line recall decline; warm-start makes this unsuitable as a clean from-scratch ablation

selection_rule: No test-set or self-built-test access was used, and no candidate was selected using test results.
reproducibility_note: C0/C1/C2/C3 have old-wave real exit receipts. C4/C5 produced complete 18k checkpoints and independent validation outputs, but the direct interactive training session did not preserve a separate shell exit-code JSON receipt.
